verification.precondition: Frozen v1 bytes, the B01 projection digest, candidate protocol bytes, and the selection contract exist.
verification.stimulus: Validate both exact source-byte pins and the frozen projection pin, then resolve absent, explicit-candidate, explicit-default, and unknown selector inputs.
verification.expectedSemanticState: An absent selector resolves only to frozen v1; protocol 2.x resolves only by its explicit candidate identifier and does not claim a circular candidate projection digest.
verification.expectedEvidenceState: node:test reports the literal assertion: protocol selection defaults implicitly to frozen v1 and exposes v2 only through explicit candidate selection
verification.forbiddenMutation: The test must not alter default selection, rewrite either protocol, generate a candidate package digest, or migrate a historical session.

behavior: protocol selection defaults implicitly to frozen v1 and exposes v2 only through explicit candidate selection
